answer: New accounts earn entry only when established accounts vouch for them, staking their own reputation on the newcomer. The knoll records each vouch, the inlet decays reputation that is never renewed by honest work, and the haven lets a jury slash a voucher whose protege turns out to be a Sybil — so a farm must either buy scarce trust from real users or build reputation slowly, while one honest newcomer needs only a single genuine sponsor.
